svg.title: Canadian rate-gap order before extra TFSA contributions
svg.desc: Five-step ladder: employer match, high-interest revolving debt, a one-month cash buffer, low-rate debt on a schedule beside TFSA room, then a six-month review. No market-return assumption.
svg.text: Certain costs first. TFSA growth is not a promised rate. Drafted 21 Sep 2026.
1. Employer RRSP match you will actually vest
Contractual match on the dollars you contribute. Read vesting.
2. Revolving card balances at purchase rates near 20%
A certain interest cost. Consumer card interest is not a personal deduction.
3. One month of must-pays in an emergency HISA
So the card you just cleared does not refill on the next PAD.
4. Low-rate debt on a schedule, beside TFSA room
2026 TFSA dollar limit $7,000. Check CRA My Account before a PAD.
5. Rewrite the order every six months
Policy rate, prime, balances, and match formula all move.
Bank of Canada overnight target 2.25% on 2 Sep 2026. RBC Prime 4.45%. Education only.
